exceptions.scope: The vulnerable Hono static-file HTTP adapter is not imported or instantiated. DraftMatter MCP is stdio-only and opens no listening port.
mitigations: Import only SDK stdio, in-memory, client, server, and schema entry points.
Reject release if the advisory becomes high or critical, reaches the stdio import path, or a compatible fixed SDK is available.
Re-run npm audit and the MCP protocol/end-to-end suites for every release.
